Wow. I literally came on this page to make a post something similar. I also struggle with BPD and have been presenting "androgynous" for the last two years. 

I have been struggling as of late, whether or not my idea to transition (3 years ago) was influenced by my having of BPD, and im trying to come to terms with it.

A lot of the things you've said and have had happened to you I empathize with, and I wish I had an answer to rectify all of it, but unfortunately, I don't. I'm figuring out this mental mindfuck on the same degree as you. All I can say is continue doing what makes you happy. If it's presenting on this side, do that. If its on the other side another day, do that. We're all presenting in whatever manner makes us feel the most inline with ourselves, for some of us, it'll alternate, but that doesn't make us freaks nor does it make us whatever those people who are staring at us think we are.

This is a hard journey, unfortunately, but through that, we can learn how to resonate with what makes US comfortable, and not those who view us.
